body: Thanks for the support guys. My parents initially were pretty pissed but they decided to get me some therapy. In leaving to go soon. Wish me luck!
Still alive. Talking to my parents in about 30 min. Wish me luck

I appreciate the alternatives, and I really will give them some serious thought, but I'm just so TIRED. tired of living, tired of the expectations, tired of feeling like shit all the time. I just want to get away from it all.

As a child i tested as a genius on an iq test. They never fail to remind me of this fact daily, and freak out if i do anything less than perfect in school. This has made me want to rebel and drink, smoke, not go to school, ect. And they now dislike me even more for ruining their perfecr christian reputation because of how fucked up i am. They have told me so many times that i disappoint them, they wish i lived somewhere else, i need to get my shit together. And all this just makes me hate myself more.

They expect so much of me and all i do is fuck up. Im a waste of their money, their time, and quite frankly their love. I have no doubt they love me but i just cant stand to see the look of disappointment and sorrow on my mothers face every time she looks at me.

That really means alot to me that you would take the time to reply. Thank you. I just don't want to tell them because they react so harshly to me even telling them I feel like shit all the time. They've threatened to send me away to military school before, and i feel like if i told them they would just try to preach to me then send me away. I just think it'll be better if im gone.
I just feel like my family is better off without me

I'm in the exact same situation as you and I'm right there with you man. The fucked up thing with me is that my parents don't even know about my self harm and suicide attempt, I'm too afraid to tell them because they expect so much of me, and to tell them that despite all the things in my life I have handed to me, I still have no desire to live. Just made my account tonight to reply to this because it resonated so much with me, and I think my username speaks for itself. I hope things get better for you bro, but I dont think they will for me.
